name_reason: Name is compliant and accurate. Convention data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain 'ui' is correct (only reader is a UI/HUD render gate in fd2_render_terrain_info_hud_panel); '_flag' suffix matches the uint8 boolean datatype; 'play_active' captures the semantics (set to 1 during active gameplay, cleared to 0 during turn/chapter/menu transitions where the terrain-info HUD must be suppressed). No Ghidra-address residue in the name. Distinct named scalar at 0x51AAC, separate from neighbor data_fd2_ui_terrain_hud_user_enabled @ 0x51AAB.
purpose: Boolean gate that enables the battle terrain-info HUD panel render only during active gameplay; cleared around turn/chapter/menu transitions so the panel is not drawn during them.
logic_summary: uint8 flag, ships set to 1. Sole reader is fd2_render_terrain_info_hud_panel (gfx/rndstat.c @ 0x1ad1b/0x1ad0c): if data_fd2_ui_terrain_hud_user_enabled==0 OR data_fd2_ui_play_active_flag==0 the panel render returns early (suppressed). Writers clear it to 0 then restore to 1 bracketing transitions: player->enemy turn cycle in fd2_check_all_player_acted_or_asleep (0x135b4/0x135d4) and fd2_field_command_menu_loop end-turn/suspend paths (0x170ba/0x17163/0x1726b/0x17277); chapter init/end + clear fanfare in main (0x25dde/0x25dea/0x25e0b/0x25e5e); chapter transition / new-game / save-load in fd2_main_menu_continue_dispatcher (0x25f04/0x25f2e/0x260de/0x26112). data_fd2_battle_anim_phase @ 0x51A83 is toggled alongside it in the turn-cycle paths.
datatype: uint8 (1-byte boolean; Ghidra reports byte len=1)
element_semantics: Scalar boolean: 1 = active gameplay (terrain-info HUD panel allowed to render); 0 = transition in progress (panel suppressed).
comment_original_issue: Original src comment was accurate but incomplete: it labeled the flag a generic 'gameplay loop active gate' without naming WHAT it gates (the terrain-info HUD panel render) and listed only main / fd2_main_menu_continue_dispatcher as the bracketing sites, omitting the player->enemy turn-cycle paths in fd2_check_all_player_acted_or_asleep and fd2_field_command_menu_loop.
notes: Plate at 0x51AAC was null (no code unit comment); created a concise PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline (data-plate mechanism) reflecting the src conclusion. Plate uses Ghidra live function name 'main' (the C entry point; src uses fd2_main via -Dmain=fd2_main). globals.h declares it extern uint8 @ 0x51AAC. Caller plate comments in fd2_render_terrain_info_hud_panel / fd2_main_menu_continue_dispatcher frame 0x51AAC as tile_anim_lookup_table[0x15]; that is an alternate legacy framing -- the live Ghidra symbol treats it as a distinct standalone named byte (accessed non-array-indexed), confirmed by decomp.
